basic_details.job_title: ECHS Ajmer & Bhilwara Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Lab Technician, Medical Officer and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Officer-in-Charge, Medical Officer, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Dental Hygienist
basic_details.post_name: ECHS Polyclinic Ajmer and ECHS Polyclinic Bhilwara
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Officer-in-Charge 63 years Medical Officer 66 years Lab Technician 56 years Pharmacist 56 years Dental Hygienist 56 years

qualification.details: Officer-in-Charge: Graduate. At least 05 years of work experience in health care institutions or managerial positions. Medical Officer: MBBS. At least 03 years of experience after internship. Additional qualifications in Medicine/Surgery are preferred. Lab Technician: (i) B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology), or (i) Matriculation/Higher Secondary/Senior Secondary (10+2) with science from a recognised institution/board and (ii) Diploma in Medical Lab Tech from a recognised institution. At least 03 years of experience as a Lab Assistant in a medical lab. Pharmacist: (i) B Pharmacy from a recognised institute, or (i) 10+2 with science stream (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) from a recognised board and (ii) an approved Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognised by the Pharmacy Council of India. The candidate must also be registered as a Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act 1948. At least 03 years of experience. Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hygienist/Class-I DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces). At least 05 years of experience in a dental lab. | Only candidates who meet the qualifications should apply. For the full eligibility conditions of each post, see the official notification.

selection_process: Candidates are selected by interview. The interview dates are tentatively in November 2026. Each candidate will be told the exact date by mobile
telephone or e-mail. Ex-servicemen get preference. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Get the application form in the required format from the ECHS website. The notice prints the address as ww.echs.gov.in.
Fill in the form. Make two copies, because the application must be sent in duplicate.
Attach self-attested photocopies of your educational qualification and work experience certificates.
Send the application to OIC, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Ajmer. It must arrive by 8 November 2026. Applications received after that date will not be accepted.
All original certificates, marksheets and degrees: 10th/Matric, 10+2, graduation, post graduation, diploma or course
Discharge book, PPO and service records
Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Ajmer: telephone 01452990855, mobile 9520864399, email [email protected]. You can also ask at the ECHS Polyclinic concerned.

content_sections.heading: About ECHS Ajmer
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme comes under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This notice comes from its ECHS Cell at Station Headquarters, Ajmer, which is hiring staff for the ECHS Polyclinics at Ajmer and Bhilwara.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by interview. The interview dates are tentatively in November 2026. Each candidate will be told the exact date by mobile, SMS, telephone or e-mail. Ex-servicemen get preference. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis. It lasts one year for ex-servicemen and 11 months for civilian candidates. Before signing the contract, the selected Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer must complete 10 days of On The Job Training (OJT). They must also get a certificate from the Officer-in-Charge of the Polyclinics. For the terms and conditions and the pay, the notice refers candidates to the ECHS website.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: The Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer will work at ECHS Polyclinic Ajmer. The Lab Technician, Pharmacist and Dental Hygienist will work at ECHS Polyclinic Bhilwara.

faq.question: Q2. Can civilians apply, or is it only for ex-servicemen?
faq.answer: Civilians can apply for every post except Officer-in-Charge, which is 100% reserved for ex-servicemen. The ESM reservation is 60% for Medical Officer and 70% for the other three posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer gets Rs. 95,000 per month. The Lab Technician, Pharmacist and Dental Hygienist each get Rs. 36,500 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract is for one year for ex-servicemen and 11 months for civilian candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What experience does a Pharmacist need?
faq.answer: At least 03 years of experience. The candidate must also be registered as a Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act 1948.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Send it to OIC, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Ajmer. Send it in duplicate, with self-attested copies of your qualification and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview is tentatively in November 2026. You will be told the exact date by mobile, SMS, telephone or e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is any travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any training before joining?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer. They must complete 10 days of On The Job Training and get a certificate before signing the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Who qualifies as a Dental Hygienist?
faq.answer: A Diploma Holder in Dental Hygienist or the Class-I DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces), with at least 05 years of experience in a dental lab. The age limit is 56 years.
